subject: Spec review 1: FAIL, 7 blocking
body: Ran /sc:spec-panel-diffgate review 1 (critique, requirements+architecture) on orca-worker-contract-spec.md and wrote review/spec-panel.md with a numbered findings list, guard boundary table and Diffgate findings block; read-only check --dry-run accepted it and derives verdict FAIL with 7 blocking findings (R1.1-R1.7: WC-4 report location unknowable for workflow/tdd/init-lite, status field collides with existing contracts, WC-6 vs WC-4 retry directory, WC-7 does not require the Skill call, AC-C1 fails on the contract file SA-2 allows, load vs AC-1.1, no --unattended parse rule) plus 6 minor notes. Left for the coordinator: run the real diffgate check step to append close-r1.md and the verdict line, and note that origin/master has moved past the spec's baseline (46 commands, /sc:issue calls Orca, src/superclaude/core/WORKER-CONTRACT.md already exists), so decide whether Task 6 revises against HEAD 2cb683f5c or current master.
